## Walkthrough The controller now waits for operand rollout completion before clearing Progressing, requeues while rollout is still in progress, and treats DaemonSets as converged based on observed generation plus updated scheduled count. Tests were updated for the new reconciliation flow and rollout helper behavior. ### Changes **Operand rollout convergence** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Rollout convergence checks**
`pkg/controllers/clusteroperator_controller.go`|The controller imports `apps/v1`, requeues while progressing, and uses rollout-completion helpers to decide when operands have converged; DaemonSet completion now depends on observed generation and updated scheduled count.| |**Progressing reconcile flow**
`pkg/controllers/clusteroperator_controller_test.go`|The progressing reconcile test now stays progressing across an incomplete rollout, patches Deployment status to completed, and then expects Available after the next reconcile.| |**Rollout helper coverage**
`pkg/controllers/clusteroperator_controller_test.go`|The helper tests now cover Deployment rollout completion and stall detection, plus DaemonSet completion semantics that ignore unavailable and misscheduled counts when generation and updated scheduling match.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes
